All the ingredients for every dish (see the tables in each step and the full shopping list).
Plan your shopping trip: by visiting only **Edron, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Thais, Carlin and Svargrond** you can buy every ingredient that is sold.

All liquids must come in {item:Vial|vials}. Buy vials of {item:Water (Liquid)|water} in Edron (8 gp each) or of {item:Oil|oil} in most cities, for example Venore (20 gp each), empty them and use them on a cask of wine, beer or mead, or use the container holding the liquid (e.g. a mug of mead) on the empty vial.

"Fresh" ingredients ({item:Dead Bat} and {item:Dead Chicken}) spoil quickly. Trick: ask another character to send you the freshly killed animal by parcel, so you only have to run from the Darashia depot.
Each dish can only be used once every 10 minutes.
Before going to Jean Pierre, it's worth gathering as many ingredients as possible. These tricks will save you a lot of trips.

Several dishes call for {item:Flour} (15 ounces in total). In **Thais**, harvest {item:Bunch of Wheat|bunches of wheat} with a {item:Scythe} or buy the wheat from {npc:Donald McRonald} for 1 gp each. Then use the wheat on a {item:Millstone} to turn it into flour.

Buy vials (of water in Edron for 8 gp, or of oil in other cities for 20 gp), empty them and fill them with {item:Beer}, {item:Wine}, {item:Mead} or {item:Milk} as the recipe requires. To transfer a liquid, use the full container (mug, bottle...) on the empty vial, or use the empty vial on a cask.
If the liquid is in a bottle, mug or any other container that isn't a vial, Jean Pierre **won't accept** it.

This table adds up the ingredients needed to make **one** of each dish (dishes 1 to 14). It does not include the {item:Zaoan Sauce}, which also needs 1 {item:Salt}, 2 vials of {item:Coconut Milk}, 1 {item:Dragonfruit}, 1 {item:Young Lich Worm} and 1 {item:Taiyaki}.

Travel to **Ankrahmun** by boat: at your city's harbour talk to the captain and say {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun} and {key:yes} (there are boats to Ankrahmun in Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore and Yalahar). You arrive at Ankrahmun's harbour, next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}.

Leave Ankrahmun to the **north** and climb the ramp up into the mountains north of the city. Follow the path to the {wiki:Ashta'daramai|Blue Djinn Fortress}: {npc:Jean Pierre}'s house is a few steps **west** of the fortress. He is 1 floor above ground level. On the way you may meet {creature:Hyaena|Hyaenas}, {creature:Larva|Larvas} and a {creature:Stone Golem}, and maybe {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads}, {creature:Honour Guard|Honour Guards}, {creature:Scarab|Scarabs} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}.

Say {key:hi}, {key:cook}, {key:recipes}, {key:apprentice} and {key:yes}. From then on you can ask him for recipes at any time.

After finishing, you can go back and cook **each dish once more per year** by bringing the ingredients again. The first time you finish the quest you end up with 14 dishes, and by repeating each recipe you can reach 28 dishes in that first year.
Jean Pierre is only at home in August (1 to 31). Outside that month you can't progress in the quest.

Dishes 11 to 14 came from the "Gourmet Competition" of May 2010: best starter ({item:Coconut Shrimp Bake}), best main course ({item:Pot of Blackjack|Blackjack}), best dessert ({item:Demonic Candy Ball|Demonic Candy Balls}) and best drink ({item:Sweet Mangonaise Elixir}).
The quantities in the shopping list are for making one of each dish; if you want to repeat, multiply.
